title: Quickstart inline doc-link cards and contextual tooltips for onboarding
creator: Avery Brooks
description: Design and deliver a set of compact, context-sensitive quickstart cards and inline doc-link tooltips for the Console. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for new users by providing targeted next-step actions, one-click links to relevant docs, and micro-screenshots that illustrate key Console flows (model selection, route setup, and test playground). Cards must be non-intrusive, responsive across desktop widths, keyboard-accessible, and compatible with both Hosted and Dedicated product variants. Provide variants for: (1) top-level Quickstart flow, (2) route/detail pages where config errors are common, and (3) the model tab where users pick a model and variant. Include localization placeholders and specs for imagery (1200x600 for hero, 360x220 for micro-shot).
acceptance_criteria: Three reusable card components: Hero quickstart, Inline hint card, Side-panel deep-link card
Each card includes a concise title, 1-line description, 1 primary CTA (link to doc or action), and optional thumbnail screenshot
Keyboard focus, screen-reader labels, and contrast meet AA accessibility
Figma frames and export-ready PNGs/SVGs for all screen sizes are delivered
Developer handoff includes CSS variables, token mapping, and example HTML/ARIA snippets
Unit tests or visual regression snapshots for the three placements are defined and handed to ENG
design_assets: Figma: Redwood Onboarding / Quickstart Cards (file: onboarding_quickstart_v3)
decisions: Use a compact card height by default (72px) with expandable detail state for first-time users
Primary CTA should deep-link into Console route when available; fallback to docs if user lacks permissions
Avoid modal-based onboarding; prefer inline cards + side panel to reduce context switching
Thumbnail images are optional and lazy-loaded to preserve Console performance
